prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original anime/game full-body adult female pose-reference contact sheet.
Primary request: EXACTLY16 distinct anatomy-correct poses in the specified cell order, each as a single complete figure with the necessary chair/stool/bench/step/floor support.
Canvas/layout: PORTRAIT 2048x3072, EXACTLY4 equal columns by4 equal rows, tall equal cells, thin straight light-gray rules at quarter axes. Row-major left to right then down. Each cell has generous margins containing the whole head, both hands, both legs and both feet, and all relevant furniture or support contacts. No overlapping cells. Put ONLY the exact ID small and dark at the top left of each cell. NO other text, headings, captions, arrows, footers, extra panels or watermarks.
Subject: SAME original mature ADULT woman age25-35 throughout, adult face and adult proportions, tied-back dark-brown ponytail. Complete opaque teal long-sleeved sport top, charcoal full-length athletic trousers, plain soft flat sneakers. Clothing remains consistent in every cell; clearly draw trouser folds and the outline of both legs, with contrasting shoe soles where needed. Ordinary practical clothed pose drawing, neutral expression, no erotic framing, no exposed underwear or skin-focus.
Style: polished professional 2D anime anatomy-reference illustration, precise clean linework, restrained cel shading, clear readable silhouette. Warm ivory background, simple floor baseline, natural consistent light, neutral original clothing with no logos. Simple pale-gray solid furniture and thin exercise mat only where called for. One figure in every cell, no ghost figures or diagrams.
Anatomy/contacts: exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet per person, correct joint directions. Feet, knees, palms and seat must visibly make the described contact, not float or merge. Keep left/right limb overlap understandable. For single-knee poses ONE knee touches floor and the OTHER foot is planted in front; do not turn every kneel into two knees on the floor. Camera at ordinary chest/hip level for the specified frontal, profile or three-quarter view; no dramatic perspective.
Sheet direction: Cells1-3 are true KNEE-OVER-KNEE chair sitting: upper thigh crosses OVER lower thigh, top knee stacked above bottom knee; bottom foot touches floor, upper foot hangs. Cell4 is DIFFERENT: FIGURE-FOUR ankle-over-opposite-knee, upper knee points outward, making a visible triangular leg opening. Cell5 crosses at ANKLES only with knees together. Cells6-16 are individually different seated silhouettes; respect the listed seat versus floor support, and full trouser coverage. A simple chair may have a back and armrests when specified. Cross-legged floor/seat sitting is ordinary relaxed tailoring-clothed reference, no extreme splits.
Ordered cells:
Cell1, ID PO205: front-view knee-over-knee seated pose / 翘二郎腿正面坐姿. Camera: 正面. Support: 坐骨、座面与左脚脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在简洁椅上，右大腿跨过左大腿，右膝叠在左膝上方；左脚平放地面，右小腿自然垂下，双手放在上侧膝部
Cell2, ID PO206: side-view knee-over-knee seated pose / 翘二郎腿侧面坐姿. Camera: 左侧面. Support: 坐骨、座面与右脚脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在简洁椅上，左大腿跨过右大腿，左膝叠在右膝上方；右脚踩地，上侧脚悬空，躯干自然直立
Cell3, ID PO207: backrest-supported crossed-knee sit / 翘二郎腿后靠坐姿. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 座面、椅背与下侧脚. Phase: 静止. Pose: 右膝跨叠左膝，背部放松靠住椅背；左脚着地，右脚自然悬垂，一前臂搭扶手，另一手放腿上
Cell4, ID PO208: figure-four ankle-over-knee seated pose / 四字腿脚踝搭膝坐. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 座面与左脚脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 右脚踝搭在左膝上方，右膝向外侧打开，腿形呈四字；左脚平放地面，双手在腿上，不画成双膝交叠
Cell5, ID PO209: ankle-crossed knees-together sit / 脚踝交叉并膝坐. Camera: 正面. Support: 座面与双前脚掌. Phase: 静止. Pose: 双膝并拢向前，小腿在脚踝处交叉；两只鞋尖轻触地面，膝部不交叠，双手叠放腿上
Cell6, ID PO210: one-knee-hug chair sit / 椅上单腿抱膝坐. Camera: 斜侧面. Support: 座面、椅上一脚与地面一脚. Phase: 静止. Pose: 一脚收上椅面，双臂轻抱该侧抬起的膝部；另一脚踩在地面，臀部稳定留在座面
Cell7, ID PO211: cross-legged chair-seat sit / 椅上盘腿坐姿. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 坐骨与椅面. Phase: 静止. Pose: 两腿都收在宽椅面上，小腿在身前交叉；双膝自然放低，双手轻搭两膝，鞋与脚完整入画
Cell8, ID PO212: high-stool feet-dangling sit / 高凳双脚悬垂坐. Camera: 侧面. Support: 坐骨与高凳座面. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在高于普通椅面的高凳上，两条小腿向下垂落；双脚离地且没有踩横档，双手扶凳缘
Cell9, ID PO213: chair-edge one-leg-extended sit / 椅边单脚前伸坐. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 座面、左脚与右脚跟. Phase: 静止. Pose: 左膝自然弯曲且左脚踩地，右腿斜向前伸、右脚跟触地；坐骨在椅前缘，双手轻搭座面两侧
Cell10, ID PO214: straddling a narrow bench / 长凳两侧跨坐. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 座面与双脚脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 骑跨窄长凳，两条腿分别落在凳子左右两侧，双脚稳稳着地；躯干直立，双手在身前轻扶凳面
Cell11, ID PO215: front-view cross-legged floor sit / 地面盘坐正面姿态. Camera: 正面. Support: 坐骨与小腿外侧. Phase: 静止. Pose: 在薄垫上盘坐，两小腿在身前交叉，双膝向两侧自然放低；双手放在膝上，背部自然伸展
Cell12, ID PO216: floor sit hugging both knees / 地面抱双膝坐姿. Camera: 斜侧面. Support: 坐骨与双脚脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在地面，两膝抬起靠近胸前，两脚仍踩地；双臂松抱小腿前侧，头部自然朝前
Cell13, ID PO217: knees-together seated step pose / 台阶并腿坐姿. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 高一级台阶座面与低一级脚底. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在上一级宽台阶边缘，双膝并拢，双脚放在低一级台阶；一手撑在身侧阶面，另一手放腿上
Cell14, ID PO218: sofa-armrest supported side-lean sit / 沙发扶手侧倚坐. Camera: 斜前面. Support: 座垫、单侧前臂与双脚. Phase: 静止. Pose: 臀部坐稳简洁沙发座垫，一侧前臂轻靠扶手，上身小幅侧倚；双腿斜向同侧，双脚着地
Cell15, ID PO219: seated floor turn with rear-hand support / 地面坐姿回身支撑. Camera: 斜后侧面. Support: 坐骨、单手掌与一脚. Phase: 转身中段. Pose: 一腿向前伸、另一膝屈起；上身回转，一手撑在身后地面，另一手搭弯曲侧膝，手脚不重叠成一团
Cell16, ID PO220: soles-together bent-knee floor sit / 地面合足屈膝坐. Camera: 正面. Support: 坐骨与双脚外侧. Phase: 静止. Pose: 坐在薄垫上，两脚脚底相对靠近身前，双膝向两侧适度打开；双手轻扶脚踝，保持长裤完整覆盖
